recipes.name: Florentine Artichoke Dip
ingredients_raw: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach - thawed, drained and squeezed dry
1 (14 ounce) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly grease a 7x11-inch baking dish.

In a medium bowl, mix together cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth. Mix in artichoke hearts, spinach, and Parmesan cheese. Season with garlic and lemon juice. Spread evenly into the prepared baking dish.
Bake covered for 20 minutes. Remove the cover, and let the dish bake uncovered for 5 more minutes or until the surface is lightly browned.

raw_recipe.headline: Florentine Artichoke Dip
raw_recipe.description: Parmesan cheese bubbles on the surface of this rich chafing-dish dipper that gets its tang from marinated artichokes. Three cloves of garlic punch up the flavor of this favorite appetizer.

review.reviewBody: Hey yo, what's up my fellow recipe experimenters?? To be perfectly honest, this dip tasted better than the ones I've eaten from restaurants.........seriously. You should definitely make some changes to it, but once you find your perfect combination, you'll be extremely satisfied. First alteration I made was halving the cream cheese. Second, I halfed the mayo and added a little sour cream. You will definitely want to do something with the artichokes if you don't purchase marinated ones, or even if you do. I chopped mine up some more after they were drained and seasoned them with two kinds of seasoned salt, onion and garlic powder, a little black pepper, a small dash of italian seasoning and a couple of drops of hot sauce (I'm from Louisiana....We put that sh** on everything! Lol). I also mixed a little garlic powder with the spinach after it was drained. Didn't use garlic cloves however next time, I will use only a couple and they'll be diced. Make sure you grease your dish with a non-stick cooking spray as well as a little Country Crock and you'll have one of the best spinach dips you've ever tasted.

Processed in Cuisinart til smooth: 8 oz. cream cheese, 1/2 c vegenaise, 1/3 c sour cream. Added to above mixture and processed til chopped: 6 oz. pkg fresh spinach, 13 oz. marinated artichoke hearts (drained), 1 c finely shredded parmesan cheese, 2 cloves garlic (pressed), 1 T fresh lemon juice, 1/4 t sea salt. Served with baguette slices 1/3 inch thick. Baked as noted in original recipe.

I absolutely loved this recipe! Perfect amount of everything. I layered it on top of chicken breasts and baked them together. I made it into a meal lol. 
I baked the chicken for 10 mins initially, took it out, layered the “dip” on top of the chicken and topped it with more parmesan. Popped it in the oven for another 12 mins and then I turned on the broiler for maybe 6 mins (rotating the pan every 2 mins) to get the perfect brown top.

I didn’t have marinated artichokes so after I cooked my frozen ones in the microwave and chopped them, I tossed them with some vinegar. 
Salt and black pepper’d the mix and I used onion and garlic powder on the chicken.
I also used light mayo. This will be my go to spinach artichoke dip from now on..... 10/10

Wow! This is my favorite appetizer!! We like it cold better than warm so that is how I make it from now on. I use the marinated artichoke hearts for extra flavor. I also add only 1 8oz package of cream cheese, put in 1/3 cup sour cream, only 2 cloves of garlic, and skip the lemon juice. I don't cook it since we like it better cold and serve it with baguette slices. I sometimes make this lower in fat for just us and it is still excellent. What I do for that is use lowfat cream cheese, nonfat sour cream, only 1/4 cup mayo and add more spinach and artichoke hearts.

I thought this was a rich and satisfying dip for munching and watching the Superbowl. Since I always read the reviews about this dip being bland and oily from the mayonnaise,( that is why I love Allrecipes!) and since it was just hubs and,I I reduced the ingredients by half,I added 1/3 cup of sour cream to cut down on the oily mayonnaise as well for extra creaminess. I added,and 1/2 teaspoon of Everything Bagel seasoning which, sounds like a odd combination,but it really kicked up the flavors for this dip. I served this with black sesame crackers,and carrot sticks and sliced jicama. I think next time,I make this dip I'll add a teaspoon of grated onion and 1 can of mild green chilies for an addition yet not spicy flaver combination. This dip can be forgiving with adding flavors without sacrificing taste.

I love love LOVE this dip!! I've been making it for years with some modifications:

1) I use 6 large cloves of garlic (we love garlic)
2) I add 6 tablespoons of lemon juice. It gives the dip a flavor kick.
3) I use Miracle Whip instead of mayo. It blends well and adds more flavor. 
4) I use marinated artichokes. Delish!!!

Thank you for this amazing recipe!!! Everyone who has tried the dip with the modifications has raved about it. It's the first thing to disappear at a party.

This is the best dip in the world. I make it for every party and people go nuts for it. It's better than other spin art dips I've tried to make before. This one has the best proportions and best flavor. Tip! Use marinated artichokes in the jar, not a can, and use about 1/4 cup of the juices from the jar in the dip. Its a flavor booster and lets you not waste the delicious artichoke juices.

oh my, oh my but this is scrumptious! I looked for a recipe that didn't contain alfredo sauce, as I don't like that. I followed the recipe as written and don't find it bland at all! I used shaved parm and probably added 1/2 cup more, and 3 large cloves of garlic. I used my mini food processor to chop the chokes and garlic, and this was a quick and effective way to get them small dice. After mixing with a hand mixer, I decided to taste it and was blown away! I realized I had forgotten the lemon, didn't know if I would miss it but I have to say that after adding the juice of one lemon, it really brightened this and I think it brings out the flavor of the choke. I wouldn't skip the lemon. I can easily see where this could be served cold, or just nuked to warm it up. I truly see myself bringing this to many functions, and have to stop myself from eating this whole thing! thank you so much for this recipe.

This is delicious as written, but I change it a tad to suit our personal preferences. I use one block of cream cheese instead of two; add 1/2-3/4 c. sour cream; a handful each mozzarella and cheddar cheeses; plus a tsp of kosher salt. I like a slightly less-thick dip, so I also add about 1/3 c. milk. Bake for 15 mins @ 375 and then turn to Lo Broil til lightly browned (about 5 mins more). Don't overcook the dip since that can result in the oils separating from the dish and causing greasiness. It really needs only to be warmed through and browned a little.

Awesome! Added 1/3 cup sour cream to the mix and omitted the lemon juice as others suggested. I put the marinated artichoke hearts (drained), the garlic and the spinach in a food processor before adding it to the mix. It was AMAZING. As a heads up make sure you drain the artichoke hearts, if you add the liquid they are packed in the the dip it will be too salty. I served it with pita bread and raw veggies. What a hit! I will definitely make this again and again and again.

I've been making this recipe for a few years now. It's the first thing to go at all my parties. I add 3/4 cup of sour cream and only use a little bit less than 8 ounces of cream cheese. I also double the spinach to two 10 oz packages. It works great in the slow cooker on low for a few hours and keeps it wardm for the party as well.
Made exactly as instructed. Was delicious!

I have been making this dip for at least 10 years without any changes . People always rave about it at parties and ask for the recipe. I like to serve it in a sour dough bread bowl. The garlic and lemon juice give the recipe a flavor better than any spinach artichoke dip I’ve ever tried.

Loved it with a few changes. I used fresh spinach, a jar of marinated artichoke hearts partially drained, 1 brick of cream cheese and added a half cup of fat free plain Greek yogurt. Also added hot pepper rings. Everyone loved it.
added green chilies
I omitted the lemon & put extra bulb of garlic w/ some bacon bits & mozzarella cheese on top. Delicious!!
Im so glad I finally found a good artichoke dip recipe!!! So delicious
Great recipe! Also added a pinch of dill and parsley. I added some shaved Parmesan to the top before baking. Always a hit at Super Bowl!
Easy to make and delicious
Very tasty. Next time, I’ll try some of the changes suggested here.
